headline: Oil Prices Rise as U.S. and Iran Discuss Deal to Suspend Gulf Attacks
context: Oil prices edged higher after an American official said the U.S. and Iran had agreed to halt attacks in a key shipping lane, raising hopes that hostilities would not escalate.

sources.name: The New York Times
